description: Synthetic, explicitly fictional workspace passages and relevance judgements authored before inference. Measures retrieval only, not factual accuracy of generated answers. This data is never imported into the operating workspace.

passages.text: Resource assessment for Valley School: the reviewed drinking water budget supports 80 people per day. Floor space supports 120 people and sanitation supports 100 people. The minimum resource limit determines accommodation capacity, so drinking water is the bottleneck.

Valley School has capacity for 80 people and 30 confirmed occupants. Its remaining available capacity is 50 people before outstanding approved reservations are considered. Arrival confirmation updates occupancy; it must not be counted twice.

Hill Community Hall has a usable ramp and an accessible toilet. It accepts households requiring wheelchair access. River School has stairs and no ramp, so it is ineligible for households requiring accessible accommodation.

The district hospital has a medical support team and accepts households with recorded medical requirements. The sports hall has no medical support. Medical assistance is a hard destination eligibility condition for a household that requires it.

Route R7 to Valley School is closed because a bridge is damaged. A verified closure excludes that road from planning. A pending, unverified citizen report does not automatically establish a road closure.

Measured route records expire for planning after 24 hours. An expired route needs refreshing from the road provider. The planning engine never substitutes straight-line distance for missing or stale road geometry.

The Census 2011 district population is a historical reference. Multiplying it by a selected exposure percentage produces scenario demand. This calculation is not a count of registered households or people actually evacuated.

Rainfall screening uses the maximum forecast daily rain in the next three days. The screening bands are a planning heuristic. They are not official disaster alerts and do not produce a calibrated flood or landslide probability.

A citizen submits an observation. An authorised officer independently reviews the original evidence, requests clarification when necessary, and records the decision. A person cannot verify their own report. AI triage suggests a category but does not establish verification.

Administrators manage accounts and district assignments. Officers can access operational records only in their assigned districts. Citizens can see their own reports and replies. Server-side permissions protect records even if a user changes the interface.

The mixed-integer planning solver keeps every household intact. It assigns the full household to one eligible destination or leaves the household unallocated. Site resource capacity, accessibility, medical needs and usable road connections constrain allocations.

Image analysis compares a photograph with candidate disaster descriptions and can identify scene regions or common objects. A model similarity score is not the probability of a future disaster. Images alone cannot certify building safety or measure structural damage.

The optional Wayanad landslide overlay is a historical NCESS 2010 susceptibility reference. Its coloured polygons show baseline susceptibility classes. They are separate from current verified incident geometry, and a green colour does not certify present safety.

The application integrates pretrained neural models. No custom training or fine-tuning was performed. Document indexing creates embeddings for retrieval without changing model weights. Quantized model files reduce memory requirements.

Account changes, report reviews and planning actions are recorded in audit history with the responsible account and time. Review notes explain the decision. The log supports accountability and investigation of changes.

The preparedness scenario uses a configurable number of passenger seats per vehicle. Vehicle trip totals account for intact household groups; a household cannot be split across trips simply to improve arithmetic seat utilisation.
